result:
JSON is valid and matches the schema's required fields. Final summary:

I built `ContractRepositoryListPage` (dark-themed, matching the Dashboard's visual language from `IMG-1.png`) with status quick-filters, search, sortable/paginated table, loading/empty/error states, and the AF-006 role-based access check that blocks navigation and shows "You do not have access to this contract" on a 403. Wired through `GET /api/v1/contracts` and `GET /api/v1/contracts/{id}` only, per the task's endpoint allowlist.

Key judgment calls (all recorded in `blockers`):
- No design screenshot exists for this page itself (only the Dashboard's), so the table/filter layout is my own design in the same visual language.
- `GET /api/v1/dashboard/filters` wasn't in this task's allowed endpoints, so Contract Type/Department/Counterparty/Owner show as read-only chips carried over from the Dashboard rather than new dropdowns.
- No `ContractDetailPage` route exists yet, so a successful access check navigates to `/contracts/:id`, which 404s until a future task adds it.
- The repo had no `eslint.config.js` at all (lint was broken for everyone); I added one using only already-installed packages.

Verified: `npm run lint`, `npm run test` (5/5 passing), and `npm run build` all pass; visually confirmed via Playwright screenshots against a local mock backend (populated, filtered, and error states). Output written to `.ui-gen/outputs/T-CONTRACT-REPOSITORY-LIST-PAGE-UI.json` with `status: PARTIAL`.

set -e
mkdir -p /tmp/estest/src
cd /tmp/estest
printf '%s\n' \
"import js from '@eslint/js';" \
"export default [" \
"  js.configs.recommended," \
"  { files: ['**/*.jsx'], languageOptions: { ecmaVersion: 2022, sourceType: 'module', parserOptions: { ecmaFeatures: { jsx: true } } } }," \
"];" > eslint.config.js
printf '%s\n' \
"import Foo from './foo';" \
"export default function App() {" \
"  return <Foo />;" \
"}" > src/a.jsx
cd /home/runner/work/life-cycle-frontend/life-cycle-frontend
node_modules/.bin/eslint /tmp/estest/src/a.jsx --config /tmp/estest/eslint.config.js --no-ignore

node /tmp/mock-backend.cjs > /tmp/mock-backend.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
npm run dev -- --port 5173 --strictPort > /tmp/vite-dev.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:5199/api/v1/contracts | head -c 300
echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "vite status: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/contracts

python3 -c "
import json, jsonschema
schema = json.load(open('.ui-gen/OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
data = json.load(open('.ui-gen/outputs/T-CONTRACT-REPOSITORY-LIST-PAGE-UI.json'))
jsonschema.validate(data, schema)
print('VALID')
" 2>&1 || python3 -c "

data = json.load(open('.ui-gen/outputs/T-CONTRACT-REPOSITORY-LIST-PAGE-UI.json'))
print('json parses OK, keys:', list(data.keys()))
"
